experiment_sources.benchmark-array-snapshot.py:
import hashlib,importlib.util,json,os
from pathlib import Path
root=Path.cwd()
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('array_suite',root/'benchmarks/eunoia/run.py')
b=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(b)
snapshot=os.environ.get('EUNOIA_LIBRARY_SNAPSHOT');base=Path(snapshot)if snapshot else root/'_build/default'
original_loadpath=b.rocq_loadpath
if snapshot:b.rocq_loadpath=lambda repo:[x.replace(str(root/'_build/default'),snapshot)for x in original_loadpath(repo)]
original_fingerprint=b.checker_fingerprint
manifest=json.loads((root/'_build/eunoia-baseline-before-opaque/manifest.json').read_text())
def fingerprint(repo):
 value=original_fingerprint(repo)
 value['loaded_array_variant']='reference'if snapshot else'opaque-proof'
 value['loaded_PArray_source_sha256']=manifest['PArray_source_sha256']if snapshot else hashlib.sha256((root/'theories/utils/PArray.v').read_bytes()).hexdigest()
 value['loaded_rocq_libraries']={rel:hashlib.sha256((base/rel).read_bytes()).hexdigest()for rel in manifest['vo_sha256']}
 return value
b.checker_fingerprint=fingerprint
raise SystemExit(b.main())

Definition byte(a:ascii):int:=let '(Ascii a b c d e f g h):=a in
 (if a then 1 else 0) lor (if b then 2 else 0) lor (if c then 4 else 0) lor
 (if d then 8 else 0) lor (if e then 16 else 0) lor (if f then 32 else 0) lor
 (if g then 64 else 0) lor (if h then 128 else 0).
Fixpoint string_hash(s:string):int:=match s with
|EmptyString=>5381|String a rest=>byte a + 33 * string_hash rest end.
Fixpoint hash(t:term):int:=match t with
|Symbol s=>string_hash s|Apply f a=>7 + 65599 * hash f + 31 * hash a end.
Definition bucket:=list(term*option term).
Definition cache:=M.t bucket.
Definition empty:cache:=M.empty bucket.
Fixpoint find(t:term)(b:bucket):option(option term):=match b with
|[]=>None|(key,v)::rest=>if term_eqb t key then Some v else find t rest end.
Definition lookup(t:term)(c:cache):option(option term):=
 match M.find(hash t)c with None=>None|Some b=>find t b end.
Definition valid(q:term->option term)(c:cache):Prop:=
 forall h b,M.find h c=Some b->forall key v,In(key,v)b->v=q key.
Lemma empty_valid:forall q,valid q empty.
Proof. intros q h b H;discriminate. Qed.
Lemma find_correct:forall q b,(forall key v,In(key,v)b->v=q key)->
 forall t v,find t b=Some v->v=q t.
Proof.
 intros q b;induction b as[|[key v]rest IH];intros H t result E;cbn in E;[discriminate|].
 destruct(term_eqb t key)eqn:Eq.
 - apply EunoiaAdapter.term_eqb_spec in Eq;subst t;inversion E;subst;apply H;now left.
 - eapply IH;[intros;apply H;now right|exact E].
Qed.
Definition query q c t:=match lookup t c with Some v=>v|None=>q t end.
Theorem query_correct:forall q c,valid q c->forall t,query q c t=q t.
Proof.
 intros q c H t;unfold query,lookup.
 destruct(M.find(hash t)c)as[b|]eqn:E;[|reflexivity].
 destruct(find t b)as[v|]eqn:Ef;[|reflexivity].
 eapply find_correct;[eapply H;exact E|exact Ef].
Qed.
Definition insert (q:term->option term) (t:term) (c:cache):=let h:=hash t in
 let b:=match M.find h c with Some b=>b|None=>[]end in M.add h((t,q t)::b)c.
Lemma insert_valid:forall q t c,valid q c->valid q(insert q t c).
Proof.
 intros q t c H h b E key v Hin;unfold insert in E.
 destruct(Uint63.eqb(hash t)h)eqn:Eq.
 - apply Uint63.eqb_spec in Eq;subst h.
   rewrite F.add_eq_o in E by apply PArray.IntOrderedType.eq_refl.
   inversion E;subst b;destruct Hin as[Eq|Hin].
   + inversion Eq;reflexivity.
   + destruct(M.find(hash t)c)as[old|]eqn:Eold;[eapply H;eassumption|contradiction].
 - rewrite F.add_neq_o in E.
   + eapply H;eassumption.
   + unfold PArray.IntOrderedType.eq;intro Contra;congruence.
Qed.
Definition state:=(nat*cache)%type.
Fixpoint seed(q:term->option term)(t:term)(s:state):state:=
 match fst s with
 |O=>s
 |S n=>match lookup t(snd s)with
  |Some _=>s
  |None=>let s':=match t with Symbol _=>s|Apply f a=>seed q a(seed q f s)end in
    match fst s' with O=>s'|S n=>(n,insert q t(snd s'))end end end.
Lemma seed_valid:forall q t s,valid q(snd s)->valid q(snd(seed q t s)).
Proof.
 intros q t;induction t as[name|f IHf a IHa];intros[n c]H;destruct n;cbn[seed fst snd];try exact H;
 destruct(lookup _ c);try exact H.
 - apply insert_valid;exact H.
 - specialize(IHa(seed q f(S n,c))(IHf(S n,c)H)).
   destruct(seed q a(seed q f(S n,c)))as[[|remaining]c']eqn:E;cbn in *;[exact IHa|].
   apply insert_valid;exact IHa.
Qed.
Definition build q seeds:=snd(fold_left(fun s t=>seed q t s)seeds(2048%nat,empty)).
Lemma fold_valid:forall q seeds s,valid q(snd s)->
 valid q(snd(fold_left(fun s t=>seed q t s)seeds s)).
Proof. intros q seeds;induction seeds;cbn;intros;[assumption|apply IHseeds;now apply seed_valid]. Qed.
Theorem build_query_correct:forall q seeds t,query q(build q seeds)t=q t.
Proof. intros;apply query_correct;apply fold_valid;apply empty_valid. Qed.
Definition seed_top(q:term->option term)(t:term)(s:state):state:=
 match fst s with O=>s|S n=>match lookup t(snd s)with
 |Some _=>s|None=>(n,insert q t(snd s))end end.
Lemma seed_top_valid:forall q t s,valid q(snd s)->valid q(snd(seed_top q t s)).
Proof. intros q t[[|n]c]H;cbn[seed_top fst snd];try exact H;destruct(lookup t c);[exact H|now apply insert_valid]. Qed.
Definition build_top q seeds:=snd(fold_left(fun s t=>seed_top q t s)seeds(2048%nat,empty)).
Lemma fold_top_valid:forall q seeds s,valid q(snd s)->
 valid q(snd(fold_left(fun s t=>seed_top q t s)seeds s)).
Proof. intros q seeds;induction seeds;cbn;intros;[assumption|apply IHseeds;now apply seed_top_valid]. Qed.
Theorem build_top_query_correct:forall q seeds t,query q(build_top q seeds)t=q t.
Proof. intros;apply query_correct;apply fold_top_valid;apply empty_valid. Qed.
Print Assumptions build_query_correct.
End QueryCache.
experimental_sources.QueryCheck.v:
From Stdlib Require Import List Bool Uint63.
From SMTCoq.utils Require Import PArray CompDec.
From SMTCoq.checker.fol Require Import State Terms.
From SMTCoq.checker.eunoia Require Import EoRuntime EoSyntax CpcGenerated EunoiaChecker
 EunoiaAdapter EunoiaLocal EunoiaLocalDirect EunoiaScope EunoiaTactic EunoiaScopedAdapter
 EunoiaMemo EunoiaModelDag.
From EunoiaDagTrial Require Import QueryCache.
Import ListNotations.
Local Open Scope uint63_scope.
Local Open Scope array_scope.
Set Implicit Arguments.
Module QueryCheck.
Definition trace:=EunoiaMemo.trace.
Definition discharge:=EunoiaMemo.discharge.
Definition cache_entry:=EunoiaMemo.cache_entry.
Definition witness_ref:=EunoiaMemo.witness_ref.
Definition payload_terms(p:EunoiaAdapter.rule_payload):list term:=
 EunoiaAdapter.arguments p++EunoiaAdapter.premise_terms p++[EunoiaAdapter.result_term p]++
 match EunoiaAdapter.source_assumption p with Some t=>[t]|None=>[]end.
Fixpoint source_terms(t:trace):list term:=match t with
|EunoiaScope.Done=>[]
|EunoiaScope.Next st rest=>payload_terms(EunoiaChecker.payload st)++source_terms rest
|EunoiaScope.Push _ _ body closing rest=>source_terms body++
 (match closing with None=>[]|Some d=>payload_terms(EunoiaScope.scope_payload d)end)++source_terms rest end.
Section Tables.
  Variable t_i : array typ_compdec.
  Variable t_func : array (Atom.tval t_i).
  Variable t_atom : array Atom.atom.
  Variable t_form : array Form.form.
  Variable names : EunoiaAdapter.naming.
  Local Notation tables_wf := (EunoiaAdapter.tables_wf t_i t_func t_atom t_form names).
  Local Notation bind_terms := (EunoiaAdapter.bind_terms t_i t_func t_atom t_form names).
  Definition cache_valid:=@EunoiaMemo.cache_valid t_i t_func t_atom t_form.
  Definition gate:=@EunoiaMemo.gate t_i t_func t_atom t_form.
  Definition gate_correct:=@EunoiaMemo.gate_correct t_i t_func t_atom t_form.
  Definition valuation := @EunoiaLocal.valuation t_i t_func t_atom t_form.
  Definition eval_with extra fuel :=
    @EunoiaScopedAdapter.eval_with t_i t_func t_atom t_form names extra fuel.
  Definition scope_eval_with extra fuel :=
    @EunoiaScopedAdapter.scope_eval_with t_i t_func t_atom t_form names extra fuel.
  Definition scope_eval_cached query encodings ready extra fuel
      (p:EunoiaAdapter.rule_payload) a c :=
    if ready && EunoiaAdapter.cached_bind_terms t_i t_func t_atom t_form names
      encodings fuel [c] (EunoiaAdapter.premise_terms p) then
    match @EunoiaScopedAdapter.scope_assumption t_i t_func t_atom t_form names fuel p a with
    |None=>None|Some pushed=>
      match CpcGenerated.derive_assuming_with extra fuel query
        (EunoiaAdapter.rule_name p) pushed (EunoiaAdapter.arguments p)(EunoiaAdapter.premise_terms p)with
      |None=>None|Some result=>
        if EoSyntax.term_eqb result(EunoiaAdapter.result_term p)&&
          EunoiaAdapter.cached_binds t_i t_func t_atom t_form names encodings fuel
            (EunoiaAdapter.result_clause p)result
        then Some(EunoiaAdapter.result_clause p)else None end end else None.
  Definition checker_with extra fuel entries capacity roots root_terms claims (t : trace) goal :=
    let ready := tables_wf in
    let names_ready := EunoiaAdapter.names_wf t_i t_func names in
    let encodings := EunoiaModelDag.encoding_entries t_i t_func t_atom t_form names fuel
      (List.concat roots ++ EunoiaScope.literals t)%list in
    let reference:=EunoiaAdapter.typeof_with_ready t_i t_func names names_ready fuel in
    let query:=QueryCache.query reference(QueryCache.build reference(root_terms++source_terms t))in
    ready && bind_terms fuel roots root_terms && cache_valid entries &&
    EunoiaScope.checker
      (EunoiaAdapter.prepared_eval_with t_i t_func t_atom t_form names encodings ready names_ready
        (fun f _=>CpcGenerated.derive_with extra f query) fuel)
      (scope_eval_cached query encodings ready extra fuel)
      (gate entries) (PArray.length t_form)
      capacity roots claims t goal.
  Definition checker := checker_with CpcGenerated.default_primitive.

  Lemma checker_with_binding : forall extra fuel entries capacity roots root_terms claims t goal,
    checker_with extra fuel entries capacity roots root_terms claims t goal = true ->
    tables_wf = true /\ bind_terms fuel roots root_terms = true /\ cache_valid entries = true.
  Proof.
    intros extra fuel entries capacity roots root_terms claims t goal H.
    unfold checker_with in H; rewrite !andb_true_iff in H; tauto.
  Qed.

  Theorem checker_with_correct : forall extra fuel entries capacity roots root_terms claims t goal,
    checker_with extra fuel entries capacity roots root_terms claims t goal = true ->
    ~ Forall (C.valid valuation) roots.
  Proof.
    intros extra fuel entries capacity roots root_terms claims t goal H.
    pose proof (checker_with_binding _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ H) as [Htables [_ Hcache]].
    unfold EunoiaAdapter.tables_wf in Htables; rewrite !andb_true_iff in Htables.
    destruct Htables as [[[Hnames Hform] Hatom] Hwt].
    unfold checker_with in H; apply andb_true_iff in H; destruct H as [_ H].
    eapply EunoiaScope.checker_correct; [ | | exact H].
    - unfold valuation, EunoiaLocal.valuation.
      apply (proj2 (Form.check_form_correct _ _ _ Hform)).
    - exact (gate_correct entries Hwt Hcache).
  Qed.

  Theorem checker_correct : forall fuel entries capacity roots root_terms claims t goal,
    checker fuel entries capacity roots root_terms claims t goal = true ->
    ~ Forall (C.valid valuation) roots.
  Proof. exact (checker_with_correct CpcGenerated.default_primitive). Qed.

  Definition checker_b_with extra fuel entries capacity l b root_terms claims t goal :=
    checker_with extra fuel entries capacity (EunoiaTactic.goal_roots l b)
      root_terms claims t goal.
  Definition checker_b := checker_b_with CpcGenerated.default_primitive.

  Theorem checker_b_with_correct : forall extra fuel entries capacity l b root_terms claims t goal,
    checker_b_with extra fuel entries capacity l b root_terms claims t goal = true ->
    Lit.interp valuation l = b.
  Proof.
    intros extra fuel entries capacity l b root_terms claims t goal H.
    apply EunoiaTactic.goal_roots_refute; eapply checker_with_correct; exact H.
  Qed.

  Theorem checker_b_correct : forall fuel entries capacity l b root_terms claims t goal,
    checker_b fuel entries capacity l b root_terms claims t goal = true ->
    Lit.interp valuation l = b.
  Proof. exact (checker_b_with_correct CpcGenerated.default_primitive). Qed.

  Definition checker_eq_with extra fuel entries capacity l1 l2 l root_terms claims t goal :=
    if Lit.is_pos l then false else
      match t_form.[Lit.blit l] with
      | Form.Fiff a b => (l1 =? a) && (l2 =? b) &&
        checker_b_with extra fuel entries capacity (Lit.neg l) true root_terms claims t goal
      | _ => false
      end.
  Definition checker_eq := checker_eq_with CpcGenerated.default_primitive.

  Theorem checker_eq_with_correct : forall extra fuel entries capacity l1 l2 l root_terms claims t goal,
    checker_eq_with extra fuel entries capacity l1 l2 l root_terms claims t goal = true ->
    Lit.interp valuation l1 = Lit.interp valuation l2.
  Proof.
    intros extra fuel entries capacity l1 l2 l root_terms claims t goal H.
    unfold checker_eq_with in H.
    destruct (Lit.is_pos l) eqn:Hsign; try discriminate.
    destruct (t_form.[Lit.blit l]) as
      [a| | |n a|ls|ls|ls|a b|a b|a b c|a ls] eqn:Hiff; try discriminate.
    rewrite !andb_true_iff in H; destruct H as [[Ha Hb] Hrun].
    apply Uint63.eqb_spec in Ha; apply Uint63.eqb_spec in Hb; subst a b.
    pose proof (checker_b_with_correct _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hrun) as Htruth.
    pose proof (checker_with_binding _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ _ Hrun) as [Htables [_ Hcache]].
    unfold EunoiaAdapter.tables_wf in Htables; rewrite !andb_true_iff in Htables.
    destruct Htables as [[[Hnames Hform] Hatom] Hwt].
    destruct (Form.check_form_correct
      (Atom.interp_form_hatom t_i t_func t_atom)
      (Atom.interp_form_hatom_bv t_i t_func t_atom) _ Hform)
      as [[Hdefault Hwf] _].
    unfold Lit.interp in Htruth.
    rewrite Lit.is_pos_neg, Hsign, Lit.blit_neg in Htruth; simpl in Htruth.
    unfold Var.interp, valuation, EunoiaLocal.valuation in Htruth.
    rewrite Form.wf_interp_form in Htruth by assumption; rewrite Hiff in Htruth.
    change (Bool.eqb (Lit.interp valuation l1) (Lit.interp valuation l2) = true) in Htruth.
    destruct (Lit.interp valuation l1), (Lit.interp valuation l2);
      simpl in Htruth; congruence.
  Qed.

  Theorem checker_eq_correct : forall fuel entries capacity l1 l2 l root_terms claims t goal,
    checker_eq fuel entries capacity l1 l2 l root_terms claims t goal = true ->
    Lit.interp valuation l1 = Lit.interp valuation l2.
  Proof. exact (checker_eq_with_correct CpcGenerated.default_primitive). Qed.
End Tables.
End QueryCheck.
